Alt text only writes the alt text of an inline data image

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>Before <img src=\"data:image/png;base64,AAAA\" alt=\"icon\"> after</p>", new ConversionOptions { InlineDataMedia = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<InlineDataMedia>("\"AltTextOnly\"", ConfigOptions)! });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
